{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.08
|arg= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Whether or not units can be in a vehicle with broken tracks/wheels.

|s1= [[isAllowedCrewInImmobile]] vehicle

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - transport

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] - allowed, [[false]] - not allowed

|x1= <sqf>
if !(isAllowedCrewInImmobile _tank) then
{
	_tank allowCrewInImmobile true;
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[allowCrewInImmobile]]
}}
